notes: Ithraz and Vexhul. No phases in the logs, so stages are counted from Vile Flood (Vexhul's Submerge). Tips come from the Method and Mythic Trap Mythic guides.

rings.label: Hadn't grabbed one when a Globule blew up

Visceral Burst.name: Rouse the Brood → Visceral Burst
Visceral Burst.what: Ithraz hits the raid and summons 10 Broodlings around the sides, one a second. Each one casts Visceral Burst, which hits the whole raid hard and stacks a DoT. Interrupting it sends the Broodling back into the water. The guides call this the main wipe on Mythic: one burst may be survivable, more than one usually isn't.
Visceral Burst.todo: Every Broodling gets kicked. Know which side and which spawn is yours, and have a backup kick ready for the last few.
fixes: Assign kicks by side and by spawn order, and put a marker on each side so every group knows its Broodlings.
Give every Broodling, 1st to 10th, a named kicker and a named backup whose kick is off cooldown. The bursts that got through came from all ten spots.
Tanks and melee help with the close ones. Protection Paladins can cover a lot of kicks on their own.
If a burst goes off, healers and personals straight away: the DoT it stacks is what kills people a few seconds later.

Caustic Globule.name: Caustic Deluge → Globules
Caustic Globule.what: Vexhul drops 15 Globules on the floor each round, one every third of a second. Walking over one grabs it: only you get an Eternal Venom stack. A Globule nobody grabs blows up 10 seconds after it lands, hits everyone and gives the whole raid a stack. On Mythic some Globules have a purple shield (Barbed Bulwark) that knocks you back until a stun or fear breaks it, and anyone who dies drops more Globules.
Caustic Globule.todo: Grab one every round unless you've been given the round off. 15 Globules for 20 people means only 5 sit out.
fixes: Name the 5 people who get each round off (tanks, highest stacks). Everyone else grabs one, every round.
Purple shield on it? Stun or fear it first, then grab it. Walking into the shield just knocks you back.
Already grabbed yours and see one still on the floor? Call it out. It blows up 10 seconds after it lands.
People dying drop extra Globules. If someone just died, look for the extras.

Eternal Venom.name: Eternal Venom
Eternal Venom.what: A DoT that never falls off and stacks. Globule soaks, Stir the Depths waves, Corrosive Spit and unsoaked Globules all add stacks. Ravenous Feast soaks take stacks off. Too many stacks kills you.
Eternal Venom.todo: Keep your own stacks low: dodge every wave and spit line, soak only your assigned Globules, and say early when you're high.
fixes: Dodge every Stir the Depths wave. They're the easiest stacks to avoid.
Call out high stacks early so the raid leader can pull you off the next soak.
Feast soaks remove stacks: send the highest-stack players into the Feast.

Ravenous Feast.name: Ravenous Feast
Ravenous Feast.what: Ithraz smashes a big circle three times. Each hit needs at least four players in it, or the full hit lands on the raid. Feasted stops the same players soaking twice, so each hit needs a different group. Each smash takes an Eternal Venom stack off its soakers.
Ravenous Feast.todo: Right side takes the first hit, left side the second, melee the third. At least four in every hit.
fixes: Right side soaks hit 1, left side hit 2, melee hit 3. Never fewer than four in a hit.
If your group lost people, fill it from another group before the Feast, not during it.
Melee avoid the knockback on hit 3 so they can soak Tainted Blood after.

Tainted Blood.name: Tainted Blood
Tainted Blood.group: Mythic only · soaks after the Feast
Tainted Blood.what: The Feast leaves blood founts for up to 8 seconds. Players within 5 yards soak them with a healing absorb. A fount that isn't fully absorbed explodes for heavy raid damage (Tainted Burst).
Tainted Blood.todo: Stand on the founts until they're gone. Healers break the absorbs.

Stone Breaker.name: Stone Breaker
Stone Breaker.what: Ithraz shoves nearby players away and marks three small circles. The tank has to soak all three smashes in order. A smash the tank misses hits the raid hard and knocks them back.
Stone Breaker.todo: Tank: be in every one of the three circles, in order. Everyone else stays out of them.
fixes: Tank: walk into all three circles in order, every time. Each one gives you a vulnerability, so plan your defensives around it.
Call the tank for every Stone Breaker. If the tank is dead or out of position, the other tank takes it.
Everyone else: you're getting shoved, so don't stand where the shove throws you into a wave or a Globule.

Caustic Deluge.name: Caustic Deluge
Caustic Deluge.what: Vexhul puts a DoT on her tank and spreads the Globules around them. It also stacks Envenomed on the tank.
Caustic Deluge.todo: Tanks: watch your Envenomed stacks and swap or use a defensive.

Stir the Depths.name: Stir the Depths
Stir the Depths.what: Raid-wide pulsing damage, and waves that cross the room. Each wave that hits you adds an Eternal Venom stack.
Stir the Depths.todo: Dodge every wave. Treat each one as lethal later in the fight.

Corrosive Spit.name: Venomous Emergence → Corrosive Spit
Corrosive Spit.what: Three Spawn of Vexhul come up and spit Corrosive Spit lines at players, adding Eternal Venom stacks.
Corrosive Spit.todo: Kill one snake straight away so it never spits, and the other two before their second spit. Dodge the lines.

Vile Flood.name: Submerge → Vile Flood
Vile Flood.what: Vexhul submerges, comes up in the middle and spins a frontal beam. Orbs around her show which way it's turning. Swirlies (Sanguine Storm) fall at the same time.
Vile Flood.todo: Stand opposite the orbs, let the beam pass, then cross. Save movement speed for the Submerge.

Sanguine Storm.name: Sanguine Storm
Sanguine Storm.what: Swirlies fall while Vile Flood is going.
Sanguine Storm.todo: Dodge the swirlies while you move away from the beam.

Coiling Ichor.name: Coiling Ichor
Coiling Ichor.what: A few players get a circle and a DoT that grows over time. When it ends they leave a puddle under them.
Coiling Ichor.todo: Take it to the edge so the puddle lands out of the way.

Toxic Fumes.name: Toxic Fumes
Toxic Fumes.what: Constant raid damage for the whole fight. Deaths to it are people who were already low.

Boss melee.name: Boss melee
Boss melee.what: Melee hits from either boss. Non-tanks dying to it were standing in front of a boss.
Boss melee.todo: Only tanks in front of the bosses.

Clotted Bolt.name: Clotted Bolt
Clotted Bolt.what: Both bosses throw a bolt when no tank is in range of them.
Clotted Bolt.todo: Tanks stay in range of their boss.
